What We Do

Fourteen integrated programmes carry out VIRD Foundation's mission — from emergency response to long-term community transformation.

PROGRAMME DIRECTORY

Twelve programmes, one continuum

Each programme below is presented in full — overview, areas of intervention and impact objectives together in one place. Jump to any programme directly:

PROGRAMME 01

Islamic Infrastructure Development

Building and strengthening the physical infrastructure that faith-based community life depends on — mosques, Islamic schools and related community facilities.

The Challenge

Many communities lack adequate mosque facilities, Islamic learning spaces and related infrastructure needed to support religious and community life.

Our Response

VIRD Foundation supports the construction, rehabilitation and equipping of mosques and Islamic community infrastructure in partnership with the communities that will use and maintain them.

Areas of Intervention

  • Mosque construction and rehabilitation
  • Islamic school infrastructure
  • Community prayer and learning facilities
  • Facility equipping and maintenance support

Impact Objectives

  • Improve access to adequate mosque and Islamic learning infrastructure
  • Support community ownership of faith-based facilities

Who We Work With

Vulnerable individuals, households and communities within VIRD Foundation's focus districts in Northern Ghana.

Where We Work

Northern Ghana. See our Where We Work page for our current focus districts.

Related projects and stories for this programme will be listed here once published.

PROGRAMME 02

Islamic Social Finance

Mobilizing Zakat, Sadaqah and Waqf toward sustainable, accountable community investment.

The Challenge

Zakat, Sadaqah and Waqf represent significant potential for community development, but require accountable, transparent channels to reach those in need effectively.

Our Response

VIRD Foundation mobilizes Islamic social finance instruments through accountable, Shariah-conscious distribution and investment mechanisms directed at verified community need.

Areas of Intervention

  • Zakat distribution
  • Sadaqah-funded interventions
  • Waqf development
  • Islamic microfinance models

Impact Objectives

  • Expand accountable Islamic social investment
  • Strengthen sustainable community financing

Who We Work With

Vulnerable individuals, households and communities within VIRD Foundation's focus districts in Northern Ghana.

Where We Work

Northern Ghana. See our Where We Work page for our current focus districts.

PROGRAMME 03

Hajj & Umrah Sponsorship

Supporting eligible individuals within our communities to fulfil the religious obligation and opportunity of Hajj and Umrah.

The Challenge

The cost of Hajj and Umrah puts this religious obligation and opportunity out of reach for many who wish to fulfil it.

Our Response

VIRD Foundation coordinates sponsorship opportunities, working with donors and the community to support eligible individuals on their pilgrimage.

Areas of Intervention

  • Sponsorship coordination
  • Beneficiary identification and vetting
  • Donor-funded pilgrimage support
  • Community nomination processes

Impact Objectives

  • Increase access to Hajj and Umrah sponsorship for eligible community members
  • Ensure a transparent, fair sponsorship process

Who We Work With

Vulnerable individuals, households and communities within VIRD Foundation's focus districts in Northern Ghana.

Where We Work

Northern Ghana. See our Where We Work page for our current focus districts.

PROGRAMME 04

Agriculture & Food Security Programme

Supporting sustainable agriculture and long-term food security for rural households.

The Challenge

Smallholder farming households often face unpredictable yields, limited inputs and climate-related pressures that threaten household food security.

Our Response

VIRD Foundation supports smallholder farmers with climate-smart agricultural practices, inputs and post-harvest storage to strengthen food security and farm resilience.

Areas of Intervention

  • Smallholder farmer support
  • Climate-smart agriculture
  • Post-harvest storage
  • Seed and input support

Impact Objectives

  • Improve household food security
  • Strengthen sustainable agricultural practices

Who We Work With

Vulnerable individuals, households and communities within VIRD Foundation's focus districts in Northern Ghana.

Where We Work

Northern Ghana. See our Where We Work page for our current focus districts.

PROGRAMME 05

Climate Change Programme

Helping communities understand, adapt to and build resilience against a changing climate.

The Challenge

Communities across Northern Ghana are increasingly exposed to unpredictable rainfall, extreme heat and other climate-related shocks that threaten livelihoods.

Our Response

VIRD Foundation supports climate adaptation planning, awareness-raising and resilience-building measures alongside the communities most exposed to climate risk.

Areas of Intervention

  • Climate risk awareness
  • Adaptation planning support
  • Climate-resilient livelihoods
  • Community-based early warning

Impact Objectives

  • Strengthen community resilience to climate shocks
  • Improve local understanding of climate adaptation

Who We Work With

Vulnerable individuals, households and communities within VIRD Foundation's focus districts in Northern Ghana.

Where We Work

PROGRAMME 06

Tree Planting under Climate Change and Environment

A dedicated reforestation and land restoration effort supporting the broader climate and environment agenda.

The Challenge

Deforestation and land degradation reduce soil fertility, water retention and resilience to climate shocks in many communities.

Our Response

VIRD Foundation coordinates community-based tree planting and land restoration activities to help rebuild environmental resilience over time.

Areas of Intervention

  • Community tree-planting drives
  • Land restoration support
  • Environmental education
  • Nursery and seedling support

Impact Objectives

  • Increase tree cover in supported communities
  • Build community ownership of environmental restoration

Vulnerable individuals, households and communities within VIRD Foundation's focus districts in Northern Ghana.

PROGRAMME 07

Water, Sanitation and Hygiene

Expanding access to clean water, sanitation and hygiene infrastructure.

The Challenge

Reliable access to clean water and safe sanitation remains a significant challenge in many communities across Northern Ghana.

Our Response

We construct and rehabilitate water and sanitation infrastructure, and promote hygiene practices, so communities can rely on safer water and sanitation over the long term.

Areas of Intervention

  • Borehole and water facility construction
  • Sanitation infrastructure
  • Hygiene promotion
  • Water resource management

Impact Objectives

  • Increase access to safe, reliable water sources
  • Improve household sanitation and hygiene practices

PROGRAMME 08

Child Protection

Safeguarding children from harm, exploitation and abuse within the communities we work with.

The Challenge

Children can face risks of harm, exploitation or exclusion from protection systems, particularly during crises or in under-resourced communities.

Our Response

VIRD Foundation strengthens community-based child protection systems, supports case referrals, and raises awareness to reduce risk and improve safety nets for children.

Areas of Intervention

  • Child protection case support
  • Community-based protection systems
  • Awareness and prevention activities
  • Referral pathway support

Impact Objectives

  • Strengthen community-based child protection systems
  • Reduce risk of harm to children

Vulnerable individuals, households and communities within VIRD Foundation's focus districts in Northern Ghana.

PROGRAMME 09

Humanitarian Programme

Rapid, dignified emergency response for communities facing crisis, displacement or acute need.

The Challenge

Communities across Northern Ghana can face sudden crises — flooding, displacement or acute shocks — that leave households without immediate access to essentials.

Our Response

VIRD Foundation delivers rapid, dignified emergency assistance and coordinates needs assessments so support reaches the people who need it most, as quickly as possible.

Areas of Intervention

  • Emergency relief distribution
  • Shelter and non-food items
  • Emergency cash and voucher assistance
  • Rapid needs assessment

Impact Objectives

  • Reduce time-to-assistance for crisis-affected communities
  • Ensure dignified, needs-based emergency response

Who We Work With

Vulnerable individuals, households and communities within VIRD Foundation's focus districts in Northern Ghana.

PROGRAMME 10

Education and Qur'an Studies

Strengthening access to quality general education alongside Qur'an studies and Islamic learning.

The Challenge

Many children and young people in our focus communities face barriers to consistent, quality education — both general schooling and Qur'an studies.

Our Response

VIRD Foundation supports school infrastructure, learning materials and community-based education initiatives that combine general education with Qur'an studies.

Areas of Intervention

  • School infrastructure support
  • Learning materials & scholarships
  • Qur'an education & libraries
  • Teacher and community support

Impact Objectives

  • Improve access to quality basic and Islamic education
  • Build human capital for long-term development

PROGRAMME 11

Health & Nutrition

Improving access to essential healthcare and nutrition services for vulnerable families.

The Challenge

Vulnerable families, particularly women and young children, often face limited access to essential healthcare and adequate nutrition.

Our Response

VIRD Foundation supports primary healthcare access, maternal and child health services, and nutrition screening to help close this gap at the community level.

Areas of Intervention

  • Primary healthcare support
  • Maternal and child health
  • Nutrition screening and support
  • Community health outreach

Impact Objectives

  • Improve access to essential health services
  • Reduce malnutrition among children under five

Vulnerable individuals, households and communities within VIRD Foundation's focus districts in Northern Ghana.

PROGRAMME 12

Strengthening Institutions

Building VIRD Foundation's own systems, governance and capacity to deliver accountable impact.

The Challenge

Delivering accountable, effective humanitarian and development work requires strong internal systems, governance and capacity — not just good intentions.

Our Response

VIRD Foundation invests in its own organizational systems, staff capacity, governance structures and MEAL systems to deliver — and account for — its work responsibly.

Areas of Intervention

  • Organizational systems development
  • Staff capacity building
  • Governance strengthening
  • MEAL systems

Impact Objectives

  • Strengthen institutional and governance capacity
  • Improve accountability and learning systems

PROGRAMME 13

Strengthening Community Institutions

Building the capacity of local, community-based and traditional institutions to lead and sustain their own development.

The Challenge

Community-based organizations, local leadership structures and traditional institutions often lack the resources or capacity to fully lead local development.

Our Response

VIRD Foundation works alongside community-based organizations, local leadership and traditional institutions to strengthen their capacity for community-led, sustainable development.

Areas of Intervention

  • Community-based organization capacity building
  • Local leadership support
  • Traditional institution engagement
  • Community governance strengthening

Impact Objectives

  • Strengthen community ownership and leadership of local development
  • Build lasting local institutional capacity

PROGRAMME 14

Livelihoods, Women and Youth Empowerment

Building sustainable income opportunities while investing directly in the leadership and economic participation of women and young people.

The Challenge

Limited access to skills training, capital and markets — combined with barriers to leadership and participation for women and youth — can trap households in cycles of economic vulnerability.

Our Response

VIRD Foundation provides vocational training, micro-enterprise support, savings groups and market linkages, with a deliberate focus on expanding opportunity for women and young people.

Areas of Intervention

  • Vocational and skills training
  • Micro-enterprise support
  • Savings and credit groups
  • Women's and youth economic empowerment
  • Mentorship and leadership development

Impact Objectives

  • Increase household incomes
  • Expand economic participation and leadership among women and youth

Vulnerable individuals, households and communities within VIRD Foundation's focus districts in Northern Ghana.
